title: How can the other four numbers be written using the greatest one?
description: Five numbers in a row are given, and the greatest is called p. The video steps down from p, one less each time, to name the other four, and checks the result with a sample value. The method is the same as the example in the book on numbers in a row.
teaching_notes: One idea: in a row, each number is one more than the one before it, so going down from the greatest takes away one more each time. Watch for students who write p plus one, p plus two when p is the greatest.

source: Suppose p is the greatest of five consecutive numbers. Descri
video_script.why: A learner names numbers in a row from the greatest one, stepping down by one each time.
video_script.anchor: five number cards in a row, each one more than the one before, with the last card marked p
video_script.payoff_line: The other four numbers are p minus four, p minus three, p minus two and p minus one.

final_answer.spoken: the other four numbers are p minus four, p minus three, p minus two and p minus one

maths_rules: p is the greatest, so it sits last in the row
one less than p is p - 1; one less than p - 1 is p - 2; then p - 3; then p - 4
in order: p - 4, p - 3, p - 2, p - 1, p
check with p = 10: 6, 7, 8, 9, 10; each is one more than the one before, and there are five
video_script.design: One idea: step down from the greatest number, one less each time. Assumes the example on numbers in a row. The five cards stay on the board and the last card is marked p.

<bookmark mark='ask'/>How can we write the other four numbers using p?

<bookmark mark='down'/>Each number is one less than the number on its right. We will step down from p.

beats.on_screen: Given: five numbers in a row; the greatest is p

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, five numbers are in a row, and the greatest is p.

beats.on_screen: To find: the other four numbers in terms of p
narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to write the other four numbers using p.

marks.one: the card left of p shows p minus one

narration: <bookmark mark='one'/>Step one, take the number right before p. It is one less than p, so it is p minus one.

marks.two: the next card to the left shows p minus two

narration: <bookmark mark='two'/>Step two, go one more step down. One less than p minus one is p minus two.

marks.three: the next card shows p minus three
marks.four: the first card shows p minus four

narration: <bookmark mark='three'/>Step three, step down again. One less than p minus two is p minus three.
<bookmark mark='four'/>One less than p minus three is p minus four, and that is the first card.

marks.put: ten is put in for p on each card
marks.row: the cards show six, seven, eight, nine and ten, each one more than the one before

narration: <bookmark mark='put'/>Step four, put the answer back with p as ten. The cards show six, seven, eight, nine and ten.
<bookmark mark='row'/>Each number is one more than the one before, and there are five of them. The check works.

beats.on_screen: Answer: p − 4, p − 3, p − 2 and p − 1
narration: <bookmark mark='ans'/>The other four numbers are p minus four, p minus three, p minus two and p minus one.
